cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two taps on the step, like yours. Welcome to the inn. Now apologise to the doorway for knocking after you arrived.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was knocking mud off my shoes. I had to get here to knock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mud removed, of course. It expected advance notice from your knuckles. Tell it you're sorry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, doorway. I did phone ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for telling the telephone first. The doorway heard about its own visitor secondhand.
